content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Spokane

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented project hours meet PMI's standards before enrolling in formal training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions at your own pace, learn from active certified practitioners, and gain the formal education PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee and await approval of your application before scheduling your test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce PMBOK® content, practice questions, and test-day strategy. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based PMP® exam at a testing center near you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) every three years to renew your certification. Choose from PMI-approved continuing education, volunteer work, or teaching to stay current and keep your credential active in your career.
